# StepFocus

One step, big: Step n of N, the number in a disc (teal with a tick when done), the words in the heading face.

## Rules (every product)

- Purple tint disc with the number; done turns teal with a white tick (and says 'done' to screen readers), never colour alone.

Tokens: `component.step` (fill, line, ink, done-fill, done-line, done-ink) in design/tokens.json.
